title: S031 4.4.2 Initialization with known network address
parent_path: S031 4.4.2 Initialization with known network address

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client begins in INIT-REBOOT state and sends a DHCPREQUEST message.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Once a DHCPACK message with an 'xid' field matching that in the client's DHCPREQUEST message arrives from any server, the client is initialized and moves to BOUND state.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client begins in INIT-REBOOT state and sends a DHCPREQUEST message broadcast on the local hardware broadcast address to the 'DHCP server' UDP port.
actions: insert known network address as 'requested IP address' option in DHCPREQUEST
generate and record random transaction identifier into 'xid' field
record local time for lease expiration computation
broadcast DHCPREQUEST to DHCP server UDP port on local hardware broadcast address

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Once a DHCPACK message with an 'xid' field matching that in the client's DHCPREQUEST message arrives from any server, the client is initialized and moves to BOUND state.
statements.pre_cond: client.state = INIT-REBOOT & message.type = DHCPACK & message.xid = client.xid
actions: record lease expiration time as sum of DHCPREQUEST send time and lease duration from DHCPACK

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The client MUST insert its known network address as a 'requested IP address' option in the DHCPREQUEST message.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The client MUST NOT include a 'server identifier' in the DHCPREQUEST message.
